translations.key: Hit a ball full and firm so the cue ball stops on the spot and the ball drops.
translations.text: Golpea una bola de lleno y con firmeza para que la blanca se pare en el sitio y la bola entre.

translations.key: Hit a ball full and firm so the cue ball stops on the spot and the ball drops.
translations.text: Frappe une bille pleine et franchement pour que la blanche s'arrête sur place et que la bille tombe.

translations.key: Hit a ball full and firm so the cue ball stops on the spot and the ball drops.
translations.text: Triff eine Kugel voll und kräftig, damit die Weiße auf der Stelle stehen bleibt und die Kugel fällt.

translations.key: Hit a ball full and firm so the cue ball stops on the spot and the ball drops.
translations.text: Colpisci una palla piena e decisa, così la bianca si ferma sul posto e la palla va in buca.

translations.key: Hit a ball full and firm so the cue ball stops on the spot and the ball drops.
translations.text: Bate numa bola em cheio e com firmeza para a branca parar no sítio e a bola entrar.

translations.key: Hit a ball full and firm so the cue ball stops on the spot and the ball drops.
translations.text: Acerte uma bola em cheio e com firmeza para a branca parar no lugar e a bola cair.

translations.key: Hit a ball full and firm so the cue ball stops on the spot and the ball drops.
translations.text: 球に厚くしっかり当てて、手球をその場で止め、球を落としましょう。

translations.key: Hit a ball full and firm so the cue ball stops on the spot and the ball drops.
translations.text: 공을 정면으로 힘 있게 맞혀서 큐볼은 그 자리에 멈추고 공은 들어가게 하세요.

translations.key: Hit a ball full and firm so the cue ball stops on the spot and the ball drops.
translations.text: 厚而有力地击中一颗球，让母球停在原地，目标球落袋。

translations.key: Hit a ball full and firm so the cue ball stops on the spot and the ball drops.
translations.text: Ударь шар полно и твёрдо, чтобы биток встал на месте, а шар упал.

translations.key: Hit a ball full and firm so the cue ball stops on the spot and the ball drops.
translations.text: اضرب كرة بامتلاء وبحزم لتتوقف البيضاء في مكانها وتسقط الكرة.

translations.key: Strike low on the cue ball so it spins back after the hit.
translations.text: Golpea la blanca por abajo para que retroceda girando tras el choque.

translations.key: Strike low on the cue ball so it spins back after the hit.
translations.text: Frappe la blanche en bas pour qu'elle revienne en tournant après l'impact.

translations.key: Strike low on the cue ball so it spins back after the hit.
translations.text: Triff die Weiße tief, damit sie nach dem Treffer zurückdreht.

translations.key: Strike low on the cue ball so it spins back after the hit.
translations.text: Colpisci la bianca in basso così torna indietro girando dopo l'impatto.

translations.key: Strike low on the cue ball so it spins back after the hit.
translations.text: Bate na branca por baixo para ela voltar para trás depois do choque.

translations.key: Strike low on the cue ball so it spins back after the hit.
translations.text: Bata na branca por baixo para ela voltar girando depois do choque.

translations.key: Strike low on the cue ball so it spins back after the hit.
translations.text: 手球の下を突いて、当たったあとに逆回転で戻らせましょう。

translations.key: Strike low on the cue ball so it spins back after the hit.
translations.text: 큐볼 아래쪽을 쳐서 맞은 뒤 회전으로 돌아오게 하세요.

translations.key: Strike low on the cue ball so it spins back after the hit.
translations.text: 击打母球下部，让它在碰撞后旋转着退回来。

translations.key: Strike low on the cue ball so it spins back after the hit.
translations.text: Бей по битку низом, чтобы после удара он закрутился назад.

translations.key: Strike low on the cue ball so it spins back after the hit.
translations.text: اضرب الكرة البيضاء من الأسفل لتدور إلى الخلف بعد الاصطدام.

translations.key: Raise the cue steeply and hit off centre so the cue ball bends before it reaches a ball.
translations.text: Levanta mucho el taco y golpea fuera del centro para que la blanca se curve antes de llegar a una bola.

translations.key: Raise the cue steeply and hit off centre so the cue ball bends before it reaches a ball.
translations.text: Lève fortement la queue et frappe hors du centre pour que la blanche se courbe avant d'atteindre une bille.

translations.key: Raise the cue steeply and hit off centre so the cue ball bends before it reaches a ball.
translations.text: Stell das Queue steil auf und triff außermittig, damit die Weiße sich biegt, bevor sie eine Kugel erreicht.

translations.key: Raise the cue steeply and hit off centre so the cue ball bends before it reaches a ball.
translations.text: Alza molto la stecca e colpisci fuori centro così la bianca curva prima di arrivare a una palla.

translations.key: Raise the cue steeply and hit off centre so the cue ball bends before it reaches a ball.
translations.text: Levanta bem o taco e bate fora do centro para a branca curvar antes de chegar a uma bola.

translations.key: Raise the cue steeply and hit off centre so the cue ball bends before it reaches a ball.
translations.text: Levante bem o taco e bata fora do centro para a branca curvar antes de chegar a uma bola.

translations.key: Raise the cue steeply and hit off centre so the cue ball bends before it reaches a ball.
translations.text: キューを大きく立てて中心を外して突き、手球が球に届く前に曲がるようにしましょう。

translations.key: Raise the cue steeply and hit off centre so the cue ball bends before it reaches a ball.
translations.text: 큐를 높이 세우고 중심을 벗어나게 쳐서 큐볼이 공에 닿기 전에 휘게 하세요.

translations.key: Raise the cue steeply and hit off centre so the cue ball bends before it reaches a ball.
translations.text: 把球杆立得很高，偏离中心击球，让母球在碰到球之前拐弯。

translations.key: Raise the cue steeply and hit off centre so the cue ball bends before it reaches a ball.
translations.text: Сильно подними кий и бей не по центру, чтобы биток изогнулся до встречи с шаром.

translations.key: Raise the cue steeply and hit off centre so the cue ball bends before it reaches a ball.
translations.text: ارفع العصا بشدة واضرب بعيداً عن المركز لتنحني البيضاء قبل أن تصل إلى كرة.

translations.key: Raise the cue and hit down on the cue ball to hop it over a ball.
translations.text: Levanta el taco y golpea la blanca hacia abajo para que salte por encima de una bola.

translations.key: Raise the cue and hit down on the cue ball to hop it over a ball.
translations.text: Lève la queue et frappe la blanche vers le bas pour la faire sauter par-dessus une bille.

translations.key: Raise the cue and hit down on the cue ball to hop it over a ball.
translations.text: Stell das Queue an und triff die Weiße nach unten, damit sie über eine Kugel hüpft.

translations.key: Raise the cue and hit down on the cue ball to hop it over a ball.
translations.text: Alza la stecca e colpisci la bianca verso il basso per farla saltare sopra una palla.

translations.key: Raise the cue and hit down on the cue ball to hop it over a ball.
translations.text: Levanta o taco e bate na branca para baixo para ela saltar por cima de uma bola.

translations.key: Raise the cue and hit down on the cue ball to hop it over a ball.
translations.text: Levante o taco e bata na branca para baixo para ela pular por cima de uma bola.

translations.key: Raise the cue and hit down on the cue ball to hop it over a ball.
translations.text: キューを立てて手球を上から突き、球を飛び越えさせましょう。

translations.key: Raise the cue and hit down on the cue ball to hop it over a ball.
translations.text: 큐를 세우고 큐볼을 아래로 내려쳐서 공을 뛰어넘게 하세요.

translations.key: Raise the cue and hit down on the cue ball to hop it over a ball.
translations.text: 抬起球杆向下击打母球，让它跳过一颗球。

translations.key: Raise the cue and hit down on the cue ball to hop it over a ball.
translations.text: Подними кий и ударь по битку сверху вниз, чтобы он перепрыгнул шар.

translations.key: Raise the cue and hit down on the cue ball to hop it over a ball.
translations.text: ارفع العصا واضرب البيضاء نحو الأسفل لتقفز فوق كرة.

translations.key: Cut a ball softly so friction at the contact turns it into the pocket.
translations.text: Corta una bola con suavidad para que el roce en el contacto la desvíe hacia la tronera.

translations.key: Cut a ball softly so friction at the contact turns it into the pocket.
translations.text: Coupe une bille en douceur pour que le frottement au contact la dévie dans la poche.

translations.key: Cut a ball softly so friction at the contact turns it into the pocket.
translations.text: Schneide eine Kugel sanft, damit die Reibung am Kontakt sie in die Tasche lenkt.

translations.key: Cut a ball softly so friction at the contact turns it into the pocket.
translations.text: Taglia una palla piano così l'attrito nel contatto la porta in buca.

translations.key: Cut a ball softly so friction at the contact turns it into the pocket.
translations.text: Corta uma bola suavemente para o atrito no contacto a desviar para o buraco.

translations.key: Cut a ball softly so friction at the contact turns it into the pocket.
translations.text: Corte uma bola suavemente para o atrito no contato desviá-la para a caçapa.

translations.key: Cut a ball softly so friction at the contact turns it into the pocket.
translations.text: 球を柔らかく薄く当てて、接触の摩擦でポケットへ向かわせましょう。

translations.key: Cut a ball softly so friction at the contact turns it into the pocket.
translations.text: 공을 부드럽게 얇게 맞혀서 접촉 마찰로 포켓에 들어가게 하세요.

translations.key: Cut a ball softly so friction at the contact turns it into the pocket.
translations.text: 轻轻切一颗球，让接触时的摩擦把它带进袋。

translations.key: Cut a ball softly so friction at the contact turns it into the pocket.
translations.text: Мягко срежь шар, чтобы трение в момент касания довернуло его в лузу.

translations.key: Cut a ball softly so friction at the contact turns it into the pocket.
translations.text: اقطع كرة بلطف ليحرفها الاحتكاك عند التلامس نحو الجيب.

translations.key: Send one ball into another so the second one drops.
translations.text: Manda una bola contra otra para que la segunda entre.

translations.key: Send one ball into another so the second one drops.
translations.text: Envoie une bille sur une autre pour que la seconde tombe.

translations.key: Send one ball into another so the second one drops.
translations.text: Schick eine Kugel auf eine andere, damit die zweite fällt.

translations.key: Send one ball into another so the second one drops.
translations.text: Manda una palla contro un'altra così la seconda va in buca.

translations.key: Send one ball into another so the second one drops.
translations.text: Manda uma bola contra outra para a segunda entrar.

translations.key: Send one ball into another so the second one drops.
translations.text: Mande uma bola contra outra para a segunda cair.

translations.key: Send one ball into another so the second one drops.
translations.text: 1つの球を別の球に当てて、2つ目の球を落としましょう。

translations.key: Send one ball into another so the second one drops.
translations.text: 한 공을 다른 공에 맞혀서 두 번째 공이 들어가게 하세요.

translations.key: Send one ball into another so the second one drops.
translations.text: 让一颗球撞向另一颗，使第二颗落袋。

translations.key: Send one ball into another so the second one drops.
translations.text: Направь один шар в другой, чтобы второй упал.

translations.key: Send one ball into another so the second one drops.
translations.text: أرسل كرة نحو أخرى لتسقط الثانية.

translations.key: Send the cue ball off a cushion first, then into a ball.
translations.text: Manda primero la blanca a una banda y luego contra una bola.

translations.key: Send the cue ball off a cushion first, then into a ball.
translations.text: Envoie d'abord la blanche sur une bande, puis sur une bille.

translations.key: Send the cue ball off a cushion first, then into a ball.
translations.text: Schick die Weiße erst an eine Bande, dann auf eine Kugel.

translations.key: Send the cue ball off a cushion first, then into a ball.
translations.text: Manda prima la bianca su una sponda, poi contro una palla.

translations.key: Send the cue ball off a cushion first, then into a ball.
translations.text: Manda primeiro a branca à tabela e depois contra uma bola.

translations.key: Send the cue ball off a cushion first, then into a ball.
translations.text: Mande primeiro a branca na tabela e depois contra uma bola.

translations.key: Send the cue ball off a cushion first, then into a ball.
translations.text: 手球をまずクッションに当て、それから球に当てましょう。

translations.key: Send the cue ball off a cushion first, then into a ball.
translations.text: 큐볼을 먼저 쿠션에 맞힌 다음 공에 맞히세요.

translations.key: Send the cue ball off a cushion first, then into a ball.
translations.text: 让母球先撞库边，再撞到一颗球。

translations.key: Send the cue ball off a cushion first, then into a ball.
translations.text: Сначала направь биток в борт, а потом в шар.

translations.key: Send the cue ball off a cushion first, then into a ball.
translations.text: أرسل البيضاء إلى الحافة أولاً، ثم نحو كرة.

translations.key: Drop a ball off a cushion.
translations.text: Mete una bola rebotando en una banda.

translations.key: Drop a ball off a cushion.
translations.text: Fais tomber une bille par la bande.

translations.key: Drop a ball off a cushion.
translations.text: Versenke eine Kugel über die Bande.

translations.key: Drop a ball off a cushion.
translations.text: Manda in buca una palla di sponda.

translations.key: Drop a ball off a cushion.
translations.text: Mete uma bola pela tabela.

translations.key: Drop a ball off a cushion.
translations.text: Encaçape uma bola pela tabela.

translations.key: Drop a ball off a cushion.
translations.text: クッションを使って球を落としましょう。

translations.key: Drop a ball off a cushion.
translations.text: 쿠션을 맞고 공이 들어가게 하세요.

translations.key: Drop a ball off a cushion.
translations.text: 让一颗球借库边落袋。

translations.key: Drop a ball off a cushion.
translations.text: Забей шар через борт.

translations.key: Drop a ball off a cushion.
translations.text: أسقط كرة عبر الحافة.

translations.key: Glance the cue ball off one ball so it knocks a second ball in.
translations.text: Haz que la blanca roce una bola y meta una segunda.

translations.key: Glance the cue ball off one ball so it knocks a second ball in.
translations.text: Fais effleurer une bille à la blanche pour qu'elle en fasse tomber une deuxième.

translations.key: Glance the cue ball off one ball so it knocks a second ball in.
translations.text: Lass die Weiße eine Kugel streifen, damit sie eine zweite versenkt.

translations.key: Glance the cue ball off one ball so it knocks a second ball in.
translations.text: Fai sfiorare una palla alla bianca così manda in buca una seconda palla.

translations.key: Glance the cue ball off one ball so it knocks a second ball in.
translations.text: Faz a branca resvalar numa bola para meter uma segunda.

translations.key: Glance the cue ball off one ball so it knocks a second ball in.
translations.text: Faça a branca resvalar numa bola para encaçapar uma segunda.

translations.key: Glance the cue ball off one ball so it knocks a second ball in.
translations.text: 手球を1つの球にかすらせ、2つ目の球を落としましょう。

translations.key: Glance the cue ball off one ball so it knocks a second ball in.
translations.text: 큐볼이 한 공을 스치고 두 번째 공을 넣게 하세요.

translations.key: Glance the cue ball off one ball so it knocks a second ball in.
translations.text: 让母球擦过一颗球，再把第二颗撞进袋。

translations.key: Glance the cue ball off one ball so it knocks a second ball in.
translations.text: Пусти биток вскользь от одного шара, чтобы он забил второй.

translations.key: Glance the cue ball off one ball so it knocks a second ball in.
translations.text: اجعل البيضاء تلامس كرة لتُسقط كرة ثانية.

translations.key: Drop two balls with one stroke.
translations.text: Mete dos bolas con un solo golpe.

translations.key: Drop two balls with one stroke.
translations.text: Fais tomber deux billes d'un seul coup.

translations.key: Drop two balls with one stroke.
translations.text: Versenke zwei Kugeln mit einem Stoß.

translations.key: Drop two balls with one stroke.
translations.text: Manda in buca due palle con un solo colpo.

translations.key: Drop two balls with one stroke.
translations.text: Mete duas bolas numa só tacada.

translations.key: Drop two balls with one stroke.
translations.text: Encaçape duas bolas com uma só tacada.

translations.key: Drop two balls with one stroke.
translations.text: 1回のショットで2つの球を落としましょう。

translations.key: Drop two balls with one stroke.
translations.text: 한 번의 샷으로 공 두 개를 넣으세요.

translations.key: Drop two balls with one stroke.
translations.text: 一杆打进两颗球。

translations.key: Drop two balls with one stroke.
translations.text: Забей два шара одним ударом.

translations.key: Drop two balls with one stroke.
translations.text: أسقط كرتين بضربة واحدة.

translations.key: Drop a ball that touches the side of the pocket on its way in.
